questions.question: If a + b + c = 11 and ab + bc + ca = 15, then what is the value of a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 11 and ab + bc + ca = 15 

**Concpet used:**

a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c)[(a + b + c)² – 3(ab + bc + ca)]

**Calculation:**

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = [11{(11)² - 3 × 15}]

⇒ [11{121 – 3 × 15] 

⇒ [11{121 – 45}]

⇒ 11 × 76 

⇒ 836

**∴ Required answer is 836**

questions.question: If a + b + c = 5, a² + b² + c² = 27, a³ + b³ + c³ = 125, then the value of (abc)/(5) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 5, a² + b² + c² = 27 and a³ + b³ + c³ = 125

**Concept used:**

a² + b² + c² = (a + b + c)² - 2(ab + bc + ca)

a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² - ab - bc - ca)

**Calculation:**

27 = 5² - 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ ab + bc + ca = -1

Now,

a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = [(a + b + c){a² + b² + c² - (ab + bc + ca)}]

⇒ 125 - 3abc = (5){27 - (-1)}

⇒ 3abc = 125 - 140

⇒ 3abc = -15

⇒ abc = -5

**∴ The value of abc/5 is -1**

questions.question: If (1 + cot²θ) + (1 + (cot2θ)⁻¹) is equal to k, then √k = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(1 + cot2θ) + (1 + (cot2θ)-1) is equal to k

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa7fd7aa9bb39d7c988cd95624d86abe1098d036099890a0b913f9b21c864ab0.png] 

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

(1 + cot²θ) + (1 + (cot²θ)⁻¹) = k

⇒ cosec²θ + (1 + tan²θ) = k

⇒ cosec²θ + sec²θ = k

⇒ 1/sin²θ + 1/cos²θ = k

⇒ (sin²θ + cos²θ)/sin²θcos²θ = k

⇒ k = 1/sin²θcos²θ

⇒ √k = 1/sinθcosθ

⇒ √k = cosecθsecθ

**∴ The value of √k is cosecθsecθ**

questions.question: In a class of 80 students (boys and girls) there are 60% girls. The average weight of the boys is 58 kg and that of the girls is 52 kg. What is the average weight (in kg) of the whole class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 80

60% are girls

The average weight of boys is 58 kg and the average weight of girls is 52 kg.

**Concept Used:**

Average weight = (Sum of the weight of all the students/Total no. of students)

**Calculation:**

Number of girls = 80 × (60/100) = 48

Number of boys = (80 - 48) = 32

Now average weight of whole class = ((32 × 58) + (48 × 52))/80 = 4352/80 = 54.4

**∴ The average weight (in kg) of the whole class will be 54.4.**

questions.question: What is the ratio of the mean proportional between 1.2 and 10.8 to the third proportional to 0.2 and 1.2?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First and third proportional = 1.2 and 10.8

First and second proportional = 0.2 and 1.2

**Concept used:**

If a, b and c are in proportion then:

Mean proportional:

⇒ b² = a × c

Third proportional:

⇒ c = b²/a

**Calculation:**

Let mean proportional be x and third proportional be y.

⇒ x² = 1.2 × 10.8

⇒ x = 3.6

Again, 

⇒ y = (1.2)²/0.2 = 7.2

Now, ratio of x to y = 3.6 : 7.2 = 1 : 2

**∴ Ratio of mean proportional to the third proportional will be 1 : 2 **

questions.question: A man covers (5)/(12) of a total journey by train, (7)/(18) of the journey by bus and the remaining 7 km on foot. His total journey (in km) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man covers 5/12 of a total journey by train,

7/18 of the journey by bus and the remaining 7 km on foot

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12 and 18 is 36

Let the total journey be 36x

Now,

Distance covered by train = 5/12 × 36x = 15x

Distance covered by bus = 7/18 × 36x = 14x

Remaining distance which is covered by foot = (36x – 15x – 14x) = 7x

According to the question,

7x = 7

⇒ x = 1

So, total journey = 36x = 36 × 1 = 36 km

**∴ His total journey (in km) is 36 km.**

questions.question: The sides AB, BC and AC of ΔABC are 12 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm, respectively. A circle is inscribed in the triangle touching AB, BC and AC at D, E and F, respectively. The ratio of the lengths of AD to CE is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides AB, BC and AC of ΔABC are 12 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm.

A circle is inscribed in the triangle touching AB, BC and AC at D, E and F.

**Concept Used:**

Length of tangents from a fixed point outside the circle is always same.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/573f6cebf0f4bfe3d26b584956f449cd063109283a9bc2bad77959482a5abf93.png] 

Let length of AD = AF = x

Length of BD = BE = y

And length of CE = CF = z

Now,

2 × (x + y + z) = (12 + 8 + 10)

⇒ x + y + z = 15

Again,

AB = (x + y) = 12 cm

BC = (y + z) = 8 cm

CA = (x + z) = 10 cm

Now, x = (x + y + z) – (y + z) = 15 – 8 = 7 cm

z = (x + y + z) – (x + y) = 15 – 12 = 3 cm

AD : CE = 7 : 3

**∴ Ratio of the lengths of AD to CE is 7 : 3**

questions.question: A sum lent at simple interest amounts to Rs.6,240.80 in one year and to Rs.7,563.20 in 4 years. The sum (in Rs.) and the rate of interest per annum, respectively, are:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since Simple Interest is constant every year, SI for 3 years = Amount₄ − Amount₁

⇒ 3 years SI = 7563.20 − 6240.80 = ₹1322.40

⇒ 1 year SI = 1322.40 ÷ 3 = ₹440.80

⇒ Principal = 6240.80 − 440.80 = ₹5800

⇒ Rate = (440.80 ÷ 5800) × 100 = 7.6%

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5800, 7.6%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount after 1 year (A₁) = ₹6240.80

Amount after 4 years (A₄) = ₹7563.20

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca7802c0f79cdccae092a74cb171e27c8b87cb65940ae2f9cfabbf71dfba811a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI for 3 years = A₄ − A₁

⇒ SI for 3 years = 7563.20 − 6240.80 = 1322.40

⇒ SI for 1 year = 1322.40 ÷ 3 = 440.80

⇒ Principal (P) = A₁ − SI for 1 year

⇒ P = 6240.80 − 440.80 = 5800

⇒ Rate of Interest (R) = (SI for 1 year × 100) ÷ P

⇒ R = (440.80 × 100) ÷ 5800

⇒ R = 44080 ÷ 5800 = 7.6%

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5800, 7.6%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

In Simple Interest, the principal remains constant every year, meaning the interest generated is the same annually. In Compound Interest, the accumulated interest of past periods is added to the principal to form the base for the next period.

Principal from Amounts Rule

If a principal becomes A₁ in T₁ years and A₂ in T₂ years under Simple Interest, the principal can be directly calculated as P = A₁ − [ (A₂ − A₁) ÷ (T₂ − T₁) ] × T₁.

Constant SI Property

Since Simple Interest does not compound, the interest accrued over any N-year period is always directly proportional to N, making it uniformly additive.

questions.question: Two circles of radii 18 cm and 12 cm intersect each other and the length of their common chord is 16 cm. Then what is the distance (in cm) between their centres?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Radii of the two circles are 18 cm and 12 cm.

The length of their common chord is 16 cm.

**Concept used:**

A line that is drawn perpendicular to the chord from the center of a circle always bisects the chord.

H² = B² + P²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91913594aa8fb525717bcc6cc8c7bef2131e66d3cf8782429636be650191b2d3.png] 

At first join O, P and A 

Now, OBA is a right angle triangle and PBA is also a right angle triangle.

Length of AB = AC/2 = 16/2 = 8 cm.

Again, OB² = 18² – 8² = 260

⇒ OB = √260 = 2√65 

And BP² = 12² – 8² = 80

⇒ BP = 4√5

Now distance between their centres is OP = OB + BP

⇒ OP = 2√65 + 4√5

⇒ OP = 2√5(2 + √13)

**∴ Distance (in cm) between their centers is 2√5(2 + √13)**

questions.question:
Study the graph which shows the target and actual production of ACs, (in thousands) of a factory over five months and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/425aee544cdada9a88b0fcf207d9cd05715870e25c4098908ce306b2d8c39418.png] 

The total target production of ACs in February, March, April, and May is what percent less than the total actual production of ACs over five months? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total target production of ACs in February, March, April and May = 30 + 80 + 90 + 100 = 300(in thousands)

Total actual production of ACs over five months = 70 + 50 + 100 + 80 + 120 = 420(in thousands)

Their difference = 420 – 300 = 120

Required % = 120/420 × 100 = 28.57% ∼ 28.6%

**∴ The required % is 28.6%**
